summary.short: Norwegian regulation under the Electronic Communications Act requiring data centre operators above a 0.5 MW threshold to register with the national communications authority before starting operations, and to meet customer-information, representative, security, preparedness and incident-reporting duties, with administrative fines. In force 1 January 2025.
summary.long: Regulation of 18 December 2024 under the Electronic Communications Act, in force 1 January 2025 and amended with effect from 1 July 2026. It covers data centre operators above a 0.5 MW threshold (§ 1-2). Operators must register with the national communications authority before starting operations, including public-sector customers, the share of power used for cryptocurrency mining and contracted capacity; existing operators had until 1 July 2025. Operators must keep customer information current and disclose it to police, prosecutors and security authorities on request, keep a representative in Norway and respond without undue delay. Chapter 2 requires a security management system, risk and vulnerability assessments, security and contingency plans and exercises, supplier oversight, notification of significant incidents, and customer warnings about threats and planned work. The authority may order independent security audits at the operator's cost, national operation of services in a crisis, and prioritisation of services after disruption. Administrative fines reach up to 5% of turnover for violations of § 15-12 of the Act and up to 30 day-fines for individuals.

notes: Consolidated text as amended by FOR-2026-06-22-1320 (in force 1 July 2026); the amendment is recorded in the document's metadata and amendment markers. The regulation is annotated as a full text, but only as it appears in the document. Internal tension: § 1-3 requires registration before operations start, while § 4-2 allows operators already active at the enactment of the act to register by 1 July 2025; the text does not reconcile these. Ekomloven is the only instrument with substantive relations, cited as the legal basis and for enforcement (chapter 15) and appeals (§ 16-7). Target instrument IDs are left empty because the targets' registry IDs were not provided.

thresholds.variable_text: terskelverdi for datasenteroperatør (ekomloven § 1-5 nr. 38 bokstav b)
thresholds.value_text: Terskelverdien etter ekomloven § 1-5 nr. 38 bokstav b er 0,5 MW.
thresholds.measurement: Not stated in this regulation; the measure is defined in ekomloven § 1-5 nr. 38.
thresholds.consequence: Sets the capacity cutoff in the operator definition that determines whether the regulation applies to a data centre operator.
thresholds.conditions: The regulation does not state whether the cutoff applies above or below the value; the definition is by reference to ekomloven. Under § 1-3 third paragraph, the authority may order operators below the threshold of particular importance to register.

evidence.quote: Terskelverdien etter ekomloven § 1-5 nr. 38 bokstav b er 0,5 MW.

obligations.summary: Data centre operator must register with Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet before starting operations, with the registration content listed in the provision (name, address, website, data centre locations, services, public-sector customers, crypto-mining power share, subscribed power, expected start, building owner).

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal registrere seg hos Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet før virksomheten starter opp.

obligations.summary: Changes to registered information, including cessation of operations and deletion from the register, must be reported to Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet as soon as possible and no later than two weeks after the change.
obligations.applies_from: after each change, no later than two weeks after the change

evidence.quote: Endringer i registrerte opplysninger, herunder om opphør av virksomheten og sletting i registeret, skal snarest mulig og senest to uker etter endringen meldes til Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet.

obligations.summary: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet may set a standard form for registration and further requirements for the registration.

evidence.quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet kan fastsette standardskjema som skal nyttes ved registreringen

obligations.summary: Operators below the 0.5 MW threshold may be ordered by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet to register if they are of particular importance; the authority may grant individual exemptions from the registration duty.
obligations.conditional_on: order by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet for operators below the threshold of particular importance

evidence.quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet kan pålegge datasenteroperatører som faller under terskelverdien, men som er av særlig viktighet, å registrere seg.

obligations.summary: Operator must keep available and up to date information on customers receiving data centre services, including where each customer's equipment is located and the customer's name, registration details, address, telephone, email and website.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal ha tilgjengelig og oppdatert informasjon om kunder som får tilgang til datasentertjenester

obligations.summary: Operator must provide customer information described in § 1-4 to the police or prosecution authority, Politiets sikkerhetstjeneste, Nasjonal sikkerhetsmyndighet and Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet, when and to the extent necessary and on written order under the stated conditions.
obligations.conditional_on: written order by the competent authority, when necessary for the stated purposes

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør har plikt til å utlevere informasjon som nevnt i § 1-4 om én eller enkelte angitte kunder til

obligations.summary: Operator must have a representative present in Norway who can meet in person, has the necessary authority and knowledge to follow up authority enquiries and assist with measures.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal ha en representant som er til stede i Norge.

obligations.summary: During working hours, operator must comply without undue delay with orders under § 1-5 and assist with measures under § 1-6; outside normal working hours it must be on standby to follow up urgent enquiries on short notice.
obligations.conditional_on: outside working hours: urgent cases concerning crime prevention or national security

evidence.quote: Innenfor arbeidstid skal datasenteroperatøren etterkomme pålegg etter § 1-5 uten ugrunnet opphold.

obligations.summary: Operator must establish and maintain a security management system describing its security work; the leader must review it periodically, make it known to employees and subcontractors to the extent appropriate, document it, and periodically check and audit related plans and documentation.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal etablere og vedlikeholde et styringssystem for sikkerhet som beskriver virksomhetens sikkerhetsarbeid.

obligations.summary: Operator must prepare and maintain risk and vulnerability assessments of sufficient scope to identify organisational, physical, logical and human security measures, assess risk from changes affecting security, and document them.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal utarbeide og vedlikeholde risiko- og sårbarhetsvurderinger for å ivareta forsvarlig sikkerhet i datasenteret.

obligations.summary: Operator must prepare, implement and maintain basic security measures (combining barriers, detection, verification and response measures), plan damage-limitation measures, have a recovery plan for an adequate security level, and document these.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal utarbeide, iverksette og vedlikeholde grunnsikringstiltak for å ivareta forsvarlig sikkerhet i datasenteret.

obligations.summary: Operator must prepare, implement and maintain security plans for information, information systems and management systems, including minimum procedures for rights allocation, access control, change, deletion, logging, redundancy, backup, maintenance and testing; the plans must be documented.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal utarbeide, iverksette og vedlikeholde planer for sikring av informasjon, informasjonssystemer og styringssystemer.

obligations.summary: Operator must prepare and maintain contingency plans to ensure adequate security, document them, regularly conduct contingency exercises, document the exercise plan, and take part in exercises arranged by the ministry or Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet on request.
obligations.conditional_on: participation in exercises by the ministry or authority on request

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal utarbeide og vedlikeholde beredskapsplaner for å ivareta forsvarlig sikkerhet i datasenteret.

obligations.summary: When Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet orders a security audit of all or part of the operation, the audit must be carried out by an independent, qualified third party, its result sent to the authority, and the operator must bear all costs.
obligations.conditional_on: order by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet where information or supervision is insufficient

evidence.quote: Revisjonen skal foretas av en uavhengig, kvalifisert tredjepart, og resultatet av revisjonen skal sendes Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet.

obligations.summary: Operator must follow up that suppliers, contractors and others performing work for or on behalf of the operator comply with security requirements set in or under law.

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal følge opp at leverandører, entreprenører og andre som utfører arbeid for eller på vegne av operatøren, etterlever sikkerhetskrav fastsatt i eller med hjemmel i lov.

obligations.summary: Operator must notify Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet without undue delay of incidents causing significant breaches of availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of the data centre or its services, with minimum content listed in the provision (cause, consequences, economic and societal impact, affected customers, geographic scope, measures, duration).

evidence.quote: En datasenteroperatør skal uten ugrunnet opphold varsle Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet om hendelser som har medført vesentlige brudd

obligations.summary: Operator must notify customers of possible protective or remedial measures under concrete and significant threats to authenticity, integrity or confidentiality (and may inform them of the threat itself where appropriate), and must notify customers of planned work that may affect the data centre services.
obligations.conditional_on: concrete and significant threats (for the threat notice); planned work (for the planned-work notice)

evidence.quote: Ved konkrete og betydelige trusler med fare for brudd på autentisitet, integritet eller konfidensialitet skal datasenteroperatør varsle kundene

obligations.summary: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet may issue regulations on more detailed notification procedures.

evidence.quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet kan gi forskrift om nærmere prosedyrer for varsling.

obligations.summary: When Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet orders it in a crisis or emergency situation, operator must operate and maintain the service with personnel and technical solutions in Norway.
obligations.conditional_on: order by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet in a crisis or emergency situation

evidence.quote: pålegge datasenteroperatørene å drifte og vedlikeholde tjenestetilbudet med personell og tekniske løsninger i Norge.

obligations.summary: When Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet orders it after disruption of data centre services, operator must prioritise important societal actors when normal operation is restored.
obligations.conditional_on: services stopped or disrupted, and prioritisation necessary to safeguard public interests, on order by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet

evidence.quote: pålegge datasenteroperatørene å prioritere viktige samfunnsaktører når normal drift skal gjenopprettes.

obligations.summary: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet supervises compliance with the regulation.

evidence.quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet fører tilsyn med at kravene i forskriften blir oppfylt

obligations.summary: Appeals against individual decisions of Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet under the regulation are decided by the ministry.

evidence.quote: Klage over enkeltvedtak fattet av Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet etter denne forskriften, avgjøres av departementet

obligations.summary: Operators that offered data centre services or operated a data centre when the Act entered into force must meet the registration duty in § 1-3 by 1 July 2025.
obligations.conditional_on: operators offering data centre services or operating a data centre at the Act's entry into force

evidence.quote: skal oppfylle registreringsplikten i § 1-3 senest 1. juli 2025.

enforcement.triggered_by: A firm, or anyone acting on its behalf, who intentionally or negligently breaches §§ 1-3, 1-4, 1-6, 1-7, 2-1, 2-2, 2-3, 2-4, 2-5, 2-7 or 2-8; or breaches an individual decision made under § 2-6, § 2-9 or § 2-10; or breaches an order made under § 1-5.
enforcement.max_penalty_text: No maximum amount is stated in § 3-2. The § 3-3 cap is tied to breaches of ekomloven § 15-12.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not stated in this text. § 3-3 lists factors for setting the amount (gravity, duration, culpability, turnover).

evidence.quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet kan ilegge et foretak overtredelsesgebyr

enforcement.triggered_by: A firm, or anyone acting on its behalf, who commits breaches under ekomloven § 15-12.
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Up to 5 percent of the firm's turnover (omsetning: total sales revenue for the last financial year).
enforcement.penalty_formula: Up to 5 percent of the firm's turnover (samlede salgsinntekt for siste regnskapsår).

evidence.quote: kan ilegge overtredelsesgebyr på inntil 5 prosent av foretakets omsetning

enforcement.triggered_by: Natural persons who intentionally or negligently commit breaches under ekomloven § 15-12.
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Up to 30 rettsgebyrer for natural persons.
enforcement.penalty_formula: Up to 30 rettsgebyrer (unit of account as written in the text).

evidence.quote: kan ilegge overtredelsesgebyr på inntil 30 rettsgebyrer for fysiske personer

enforcement.triggered_by: Breaches of the regulation's requirements, as supervised under § 3-1.
enforcement.max_penalty_text: The text refers to sanctions under ekomloven chapter 15 without stating amounts.

evidence.quote: gjennomføre sanksjoner etter ekomloven kapittel 15
